functional_semantics.triton: out[r, c] = fp16(fp32(x[r, c]) * fp32(state_x[r]) * (1/127)) (impl_triton.py L24-28); output allocated fp16 (L46).
functional_semantics.cutile: Same expression (impl_cutile.py L31-35); output allocated fp16 (L45).
functional_semantics.note: Both match impl_torch.py L7: (state_x.unsqueeze(1) * x * (1.0/127.0)).to(float16); int8 x, fp32 per-row scale, fp16 output.

stages.triton: One kernel, grid (rows, ceil(cols/CHUNK)): load int8 slice masked other=0 (L24), load row scale (L25), multiply (L27), store fp16 masked (L28).
stages.cutile: One kernel, grid (rows, ceil(cols/chunk), 1): zero-padded (1, CHUNK) load (L27-30), (1,) scale load (L32), multiply (L34), store fp16 (L35).
stages.note: Single element-wise pass on both sides; no intermediates.

dependencies.triton: No inter-program dependency; each program reads its x slice and scale and writes its output slice (L17-28).

precision.triton: x and scale cast to fp32 (L24-25); product x * scale * _INV_127 with _INV_127 = tl.constexpr(1.0/127.0) (L8, L27); single rounding to fp16 at the store (L28).
precision.cutile: ct.astype float32 on x and scale (L31, L33); x_f32 * scale * _INV_127 with _INV_127 = 1.0/127.0 (L19, L34); ct.astype float16 at the store (L35).
precision.note: Same fp32 path, same operand order (x * scale) * (1/127), same single final rounding; multiply-by-reciprocal on both sides.

preprocessing.triton: Output allocation only (L46); no contiguous()/cast; the kernel assumes row-major contiguous x (offset row * COLS + col, L22).
preprocessing.cutile: Output allocation only (L45); 2-D tile indexing assumes the (rows, cols) layout (L28).
preprocessing.note: Neither side copies, casts or caches anything; both assume contiguous inputs as generated (tensors.py L182-183).

mutation.triton: No input written; fresh output per call (L46).
mutation.cutile: No input written; fresh output per call (L45).

fq_boundary.note: Literal byte widths (1 B int8 read, 4 B fp32 scale per row, 2 B fp16 write) match the compulsory traffic of the single kernel on both sides; the per-(row, chunk) re-read of the row scale is not counted and is negligible. No preprocessing or prepacked input exists. The formula is only valid for the int8 case fixed in config.yaml.
